title: One-pot native barcoding of amplicons (Ultra II AMII ligation)
author: Josh Quick
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdaqi2dw

steps.title: Prepare End Prep Reaction
steps.instruction: Set up the following reaction for each sample:

substeps.instruction: Add 12.5 µL DNA amplicons (5ng)
Add 1.75 µL Ultra II End Prep Reaction Buffer
Add 0.75 µL Ultra II End Prep Enzyme Mix (Total volume: 15 µL)
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes
Incubate at 65 °C for 5 minutes
Incubate on ice for 1 minute

steps.title: Perform Native Barcoding Ligation
steps.instruction: Add the following components directly to the previous reactions, using one native barcode from EXP-NBD104 (1-12) or EXP-NBD114 (13-24) per sample (use 6 to 24 barcodes per library):

substeps.instruction: Add 2.5 µL NBXX barcode
Add 17.5 µL Ultra II Ligation Master Mix
Add 0.5 µL Ligation Enhancer (Total volume: 35.5 µL)
Incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes
Incubate at 70 °C for 10 minutes to inactivate DNA ligase
Incubate on ice for 1 minute

steps.title: Pool and Clean-up Barcoded Fragments
steps.instruction: Pool all barcoded fragments into a new 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube and perform a SPRI bead clean-up.

substeps.instruction: Elute in 45 µL

steps.title: Quantify Barcoded Amplicon Pools
steps.instruction: Quantify the barcoded amplicon pools using the Quantus Fluorometer with the ONE dsDNA assay.

steps.title: Set up AMII Adapter Ligation
steps.instruction: Set up the following reaction, ensuring the input of barcoded amplicon pools is between 40 ng (for 8 barcodes) and 120 ng (for 24 barcodes):

substeps.instruction: Add 44 µL Barcoded amplicon pools
Add 5 µL AMII adaptor
Add 50 µL Ultra II Ligation Master Mix
Add 1 µL Ligation Enhancer (Total volume: 100 µL)

steps.title: Incubate Adapter Ligation
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction at room temperature for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Perform First SPRI Bead Clean-up
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL (1:1) of thoroughly vortexed SPRI beads to the sample tube and mix gently by flicking or pipetting.

substeps.instruction: Pulse centrifuge to collect liquid at the bottom
Incubate at 37 °C for 10 minutes
Place on magnetic rack and incubate for 2 minutes or until the supernatant is completely clear
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant without touching the bead pellet

steps.title: Perform First SFB Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the beads using SFB to remove excess adapter:

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL SFB and resuspend beads completely by pipette mixing
Pulse centrifuge to collect liquid at the bottom
Remove and discard the supernatant

steps.title: Perform Second SFB Wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the SFB wash process one more time:

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL SFB and resuspend beads completely by pipette mixing
Pulse centrifuge to collect liquid at the bottom
Remove and discard the supernatant

steps.title: Final Library Elution
steps.instruction: Recover the final library from the beads:

substeps.instruction: Pulse centrifuge and remove any residual SFB (do not air dry)
Add 13 µL EB and resuspend beads by pipette mixing
Incubate at 37 °C for 10 minutes
Place on magnetic rack
Transfer final library to a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube
